execution_trace.llm_limitation: n8n Ollama node (lmChatOllama typeVersion 1) does not expose a temperature parameter — metadata.temperature is therefore null. Temperature is governed by the Ollama server default (typically 0.8). To override it, set the value in the Ollama Modelfile or replace the native Ollama node with an HTTP Request node and pass temperature in the request body. Token counts are character-length estimates (chars ÷ 4) because the Ollama node does not return token usage data natively.
